blockers: The face reads as a featureless white mask at native 1x; the tiny eyes and mouth do not establish a convincing expression or facial structure and create an uncanny doll-like result.

The signature gesture does not communicate a strong, deliberate action at a glance. The 24-frame strip appears to contain mostly minor arm and weapon displacement rather than a readable anticipation, gesture, overshoot, and settle.
The rapier is too thin and low-contrast in multiple directions, especially side and three-quarter views. It frequently merges with the dark costume or checkerboard background.

Celina's silhouette is not sufficiently distinctive: the broad armored shoulder/collar mass, cylindrical torso, and extremely narrow lower body resolve as a generic mannequin rather than a controlled duelist.
Locomotion lacks convincing kinetic weight. Leg changes are present, but the torso, shoulders, and weapon do not counterbalance the stride enough to sell a deliberate walking personality.
high_value_changes: Redesign the head at native 1x with a stronger readable face: reduce the blank white area, place eyes and mouth with deliberate asymmetry or expression, and add one or two high-value facial planes without introducing noisy detail.
Give the collar and shoulder silhouette a more intentional duelist rhythm: narrow or reshape the central torso, clarify the waist, and make the rapier hand/guard a recognizable silhouette feature.
Increase rapier readability with a controlled bright edge, distinct guard, and a small separation gap from the legs and coat. Test every direction against both dark and light backgrounds.

Rebuild the gesture around clear pose stages: compressed anticipation, decisive extension or presentation, brief overshoot, and a restrained settle. Preserve the contained personality through small amplitude, not through near-static poses.

Add torso-led motion to locomotion: subtle vertical compression, shoulder counter-rotation, hip lead, and weapon lag. Keep the feet on the 0px anchor while making contact and passing poses visibly distinct.
Separate navy, obsidian, gloves, brass, and skin with fewer but more decisive value bands. Several dark costume regions currently collapse into one mass at native scale.
optional_notes: The 119.8px standing height and 0px ground-anchor drift satisfy the stated technical contract.
The 4x nearest-neighbor enlargement exposes soft, painterly gradients and narrow detail that do not survive as intentional pixel-scale shapes at native resolution.
The frontal idle is orderly but too symmetrical and inert to establish Celina's personality; a small asymmetry in stance, sword angle, or shoulder height would improve character ownership.
The white gloves and face are among the strongest attention magnets, but they currently compete with the brass accents rather than forming a controlled focal hierarchy.
regressions_from_previous: No previous-round visual sheet or scored baseline was supplied, so specific regressions cannot be verified.
Potential regression risk: the restrained motion brief appears to have been interpreted as minimal motion, reducing gesture readability and kinetic personality rather than merely reducing amplitude.
strongest_improvements: Technical anchor compliance is clean, with no measurable ground drift.
The navy-and-brass concept is present and directionally coherent.
The character remains legible as a tall, armored, rapier-bearing figure across the eight directional views.
The frame organization and 16-frame idle, 64-frame locomotion, and 24-frame gesture coverage provide a usable production structure.
luna_evaluation.single_most_important_next_change: Rebuild the signature gesture and face together at native 1x: make the face express controlled intent and make the gesture read unmistakably through anticipation, weapon presentation, overshoot, and settle before adding any further rendering polish.
